method: Actual component functions and handlers with manual React hook storage and static DOM markup. No browser scheduler, runtime transport, reload persistence or live API proof.

checks.name: ambiguous upload retries exactly and same-tick repeated click sends once
refresh clears old result, keeps parent and freezes ambiguous refresh retry
analysis retry freezes exact input-only body; deliberate title edit creates new request
successful analysis shows acceptance and disables a second submit
correction hides generate; deliberate option correction issues distinct upload
last file selection wins even when an earlier file read completes later
exact source amount strings render without number conversion; row cap is explicit
live upload with NO-HANDLER performs zero transport and exposes retry state
remount demonstrably loses in-memory attempt; persistence is not claimed
